title: Electronics Cap by Unit Class Security on First Bluegate Tenant Protection Plan Claim Decisions
content:
**Rule.** On a first decision on a Bluegate Tenant Protection Plan claim, the electronics value is capped at the decision's electronics cap: the level's electronics sublimit multiplied by 1.5 when the covered unit's class includes an individual door alarm, by 1.25 when the class has no door alarm and no drive-up access, and by 1 otherwise. The class features are those of the unit class of the covered Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement.

## Decision matrix

| Unit class: individual door alarm | Unit class: drive-up access | Decision's electronics cap |
| --- | --- | --- |
| included | either | sublimit multiplied by 1.5 |
| not included | none | sublimit multiplied by 1.25 |
| not included | drive-up | sublimit multiplied by 1 |

## Hypothetical cases

- A unit whose class has a door alarm: with an electronics sublimit of 2,200.00 the cap is 3,300.00.
- An interior unit whose class has neither a door alarm nor drive-up access: 2,200.00 becomes 2,750.00.
- A drive-up unit whose class has no door alarm: the cap stays 2,200.00.
